name: custos-eth-usd-market-commands
description: The quality gates CI runs for the contracts and the app, plus a credential-free check of the new market's config. Nothing here needs keys or the network beyond installing packages.

commands.name: markets-config
commands.purpose: markets.json has ETH-USD, and every market is inside the limits PriceGuard enforces.

commands.name: eth-usd-test
commands.purpose: The ETH-specific test: sizing in ETH units, liquidation by the network, a profitable short. Fails if the file is missing (forge treats no matching tests as success).

commands.name: foundry-test
commands.purpose: Every contract test and invariant, including Markets.t.sol, which cycles every market in markets.json.

commands.name: foundry-lint
commands.purpose: forge fmt and prettier checks for the contracts package.

commands.name: next-check-types
commands.purpose: The app still type-checks against the contract ABIs.
